subject: Math
skill: Inference From Sample Statistics And Margin Of Error
prompt: A researcher surveyed a random sample of $150$ high school students about whether they participate in after-school activities. Based on the sample, $64%$ of students participate in after-school activities, with an associated margin of error of $8$ percentage points. Which of the following is the most appropriate conclusion about the percentage of all students at the high school who participate in after-school activities?

choices.A: Exactly $64%$ of all students participate in after-school activities.
choices.B: It is plausible that between $56%$ and $72%$ of all students participate in after-school activities.
choices.C: It is plausible that between $56%$ and $64%$ of all students participate in after-school activities.
choices.D: It is plausible that fewer than $56%$ or more than $72%$ of all students participate in after-school activities.

explanation: Choice B is correct. The sample proportion is $64\%$ with a margin of error of $8$ percentage points. The plausible range for the population proportion is $64\% - 8\% = 56\%$ to $64\% + 8\% = 72\%$.
